properties.stratigraphy: Glacial till over stratified sedimentary quartz-arenite sandstone and mudstone
properties.drainage: Steep north-facing hydrological runoff descending toward the Water of Leith valley
properties.local_quarry_lithics: Craigleith and Hailes pale blonde to grey-buff sandstone ashlar

properties.primary_surfacing: Granite setts, Caithness flagstone walkways, and heavily sloped wooded valley loam
properties.micro_grading: Steep topographical drop from the south-facing Moray Estate crescent terraces down into the Water of Leith gorge
properties.wear_patina: Historic urban weathering, moss accumulation on lower stone boundary walls

properties.understory: Dense mature decurrent broadleaf deciduous canopy within the Dean Valley / Moray Place private pleasure gardens
properties.groundcover: Hedera helix, woodland perennial ground flora, naturalized mosses

properties.typology: Georgian Neoclassical / Regency Palace-Fronted Terraced Crescent (Moray Estate)

structures.name: Moray Place Rear Terrace & Darnaway/Doune Terraces
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Scottish slate with lead hips, stone-coped parapets, and massive ashlar chimney stacks with clay pots
structures.facade_material: Finely dressed Craigleith blonde sandstone ashlar with rusticated lower basements and droved ashlar rear elevations
structures.fenestration: Recessed timber sash and case windows (12-pane and 6-pane configurations) with clean geometric stone architraves
structures.weathering_patina: Atmospheric soot staining and natural grey mineral patina on historic exposed sandstone

properties.street_furniture: Fixed cast-iron railings, stone retaining balustrades, period gas-bracket standard fixtures

properties.sky_condition: Clean standard midday daylight with distinct directional shadows
